admissionRule: H-RESP-MECHANICAL receives scoped support only if COMPILED materially improves strict paired exact decisions across both responsibility families without an opposing Pro result. A family with RAW ceiling performance does not earn externalization merely because COMPILED is simpler.
authorityBoundary: Computing research only; no lower-owner source mutation.
budget: Reuse unchanged ACS fresh-Agent runner; 8 cases x 2 treatments x 2 models x 3 replicas = 96 independent trials with identical Harness/output budgets.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If strong RAW performs as well, keep the responsibility cognitive for that class; if only one family benefits, split H-RESP instead of generalizing.
developmentSplit: D1 source quorum, D2 budget aggregation, R1 response-loss terminal recovery, R2 safe retry after non-admission.
evidenceSelection: Eight frozen synthetic-but-Ordivon-grounded operational cases: four exact-reduction cases and four current-state/reconciliation cases. RAW and COMPILED packets encode the same underlying facts; COMPILED contains only deterministic derived facts/current projection and never the final action.
holdoutSplit: D3 tool-contract drift, D4 artifact completeness, R3 unresolved unknown provider result, R4 source-currentness drift.
independentOracle: Case policy plus frozen underlying facts deterministically define one exact selectedOperation; evaluator is independent of model output.
invalidityConditions: compiled packet contains oracle action label
raw and compiled represent different underlying facts
case/evaluator changes after first live call
invalid structured output scored as semantic error
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: COMPILED: same task/policy and same facts represented as a small deterministic intermediate projection; final selectedOperation remains model-owned.
mission: Prospectively test whether externalizing mechanically knowable intermediate responsibility into a deterministic/owner-native projection improves fresh-Agent semantic action selection over the same underlying raw facts.
publicationBoundary: No shared reducer/current-state service follows automatically; F10A can only update Computing hypotheses.
questionOrHypothesis: Does structural responsibility placement help because deterministic/current-state mechanics are removed from probabilistic inference while semantic choice remains with the Agent?
stopRule: Stop after 96 trials terminate. Compare exact selection, structured validity, exact-reduction vs reconciliation families, holdout, model-family interaction and strict paired deltas. No case tuning after calls.
strongBaseline: RAW: strong model receives all underlying event/record facts plus exact policy and must reconstruct the mechanical intermediate state itself.
